steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each item is placed by whether it fits the capacity, was carried over, and has an estimate.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: the sprint scope is above capacity

findings.title: Scope above capacity
findings.fix: Remove items until the scope fits

findings.title: Item with no estimate
findings.fix: Estimate the item before it is committed

findings.title: Carried-over item with no reason
findings.fix: Record why it was carried over

outcome.notChecked: The team's actual velocity beyond the sheet.

input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-sprint-plan skill on the records for this review.
